title: AssessmentScope
description: What one agent run is permitted to look at. Produced by the platform from an authorization that already passed the Milestone 2 centralized authorization service; never proposed, extended or edited by the model. The gateway refuses any tool call whose subject is not named here, so this document is the outer bound of a run rather than a hint about it.

organization_id.description: Every evidence identifier the run may read must belong to this organization. Checked against the database, not against the request.

subjects.description: Canonical host names already authorized for this assessment.

expires_at.description: A scope outlives neither its authorization nor the run. Past this, every tool call is refused regardless of what else is true.
